title: Survive a flaky service

requests.name: a retry gets past the first failure: /product/apple
it keeps working on the next request
a stock of 0 is a valid answer, not a failure
a service that always fails gives the fallback
a slow service is cut off by the timeout and gives the fallback
the shop is still healthy afterwards

hints: fetch(url, { signal: AbortSignal.timeout(500) }) rejects after 500 ms.
Loop up to 3 times. Return the response as soon as its status is below 500. Remember the error otherwise, and throw it after the loop.
After the retry helper: a 404 becomes your own 404. Do not test `if (!data.stock)`: 0 is falsy.
Wrap the helper in try/catch. In the catch, answer 200 with { item, stock: null, degraded: true }.
